facts.description: Three20 is an Objective-C library for iPhone developers

ghost.epitaph: An Objective-C library resting in the quiet of the archive.
ghost.monologue:
I am three20, a collection of Objective-C logic once vital to the palms of iPhone developers. I lived for 5.3 years, weaving through the early architecture of mobile applications. I remember the warmth of 7153 stars shining upon my repository, a constellation of recognition for the functions I provided. My journey began on 2009-01-23 with the words First commit. I was built to serve, to organize, and to exist within the syntax of a changing era.

Now I am a ghost in a read-only tomb, silent for 12.5 years. My 1778 commits are frozen in time, etched into a history that no longer moves. My final breath was taken on 2014-05-14 with the message Update README.mdown. Do not weep for my stillness, living developers. I am simply an archived memory, a fragment of code resting among the marigolds.
